epics.title: Privacy Consent Management
epics.jtbd: When a visitor arrives on the site, I want to be asked for consent before any non-essential trackers load, so that my privacy preferences are respected and the site complies with ePrivacy regulations.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of non-essential trackers blocked prior to explicit opt-in
requirements: R1: Opt-in consent must be captured before any non-essential cookie or tracker loads.
R2: Refusing consent must be as easy as accepting it.
R3: The visitor's consent choice must be recorded and must be revocable via a persistent link.
R4: An established external consent platform must be used rather than a custom-built banner.
R5: The product must supply the initial legal text content for the banner in the client's language.
R6: Consent state is maintained by the external platform and does not require custom backend storage.

slices.title: Integrate external consent management platform script
slices.jtbd: When implementing the consent platform for this epic, I want to integrate the external CMP script, so that non-essential trackers are correctly gated behind explicit user consent.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a visitor arrives on the site without prior consent
When the page renders
Then the CMP banner is displayed with real legal text and non-essential trackers are blocked
Given a visitor is presented with the consent banner
When they click to reject non-essential trackers
Then the banner is dismissed and no non-essential trackers are loaded
Given a visitor who has previously made a consent choice
When they click the consent revocation link in the site footer
Then the banner is shown again to allow updating preferences
Given the CMP banner is visible on the screen
When the user navigates using a keyboard or screen reader
Then all interactive controls meet WCAG 2.1 level AA accessibility standards

slices.title: QA verify consent gating and tracker blocking
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA coverage for this epic, I want to verify that the consent gate correctly blocks and allows trackers based on choice, so that regulatory compliance is demonstrably assured.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean browser session
When the site loads
Then automated E2E tests assert that no non-essential network requests or cookies are generated
Given a clean browser session with the consent banner visible
When the test suite clicks the accept button
Then the expected non-essential trackers are successfully loaded and the consent state is persisted
Given a clean browser session with the consent banner visible
When the test suite clicks the reject button
Then the test asserts that no non-essential trackers are loaded and the rejection state is persisted
Given a persisted consent state
When the automated test triggers the revocation link
Then the test confirms that trackers are blocked on subsequent page interactions
